text: DSH Weave 是面向 DSH Web 的跨主机连接插件，通过 Iroh 将明确配对的 DeepSeek Harness 主机连接起来。它接入 DSH transport service，提供可持久化的主机身份、交换 ticket 后的显式配对、受信任节点间的消息传输，以及远程工作区和会话目录查询。设置页可查看本机 ticket、添加或移除配对主机并查看连接状态；工具也支持创建 ticket、信任节点和列出已信任节点。适合需要让多台 DSH 主机互通、并由上层插件使用远程会话目录的场景。使用时需在各主机之间通过可信渠道交换 ticket；无需 API Key。

DSH Weave connects paired DSH hosts over Iroh, providing persistent identity, ticket pairing, trusted peer messaging, and remote session catalogs. Settings manage pairing and host status; tools create tickets and manage peers. Exchange tickets through a trusted channel; no API key is needed.

DSH Weave 的功能「主机配对」：通过设置页输入对方 Iroh ticket，或调用信任工具，将该节点加入本机受信任列表并保存配对信息。
DSH Weave 的功能「远程会话目录」：向已配对主机请求目录，返回其未归档工作区及会话标题、运行状态和更新时间，供上层插件选择。
DSH Weave 的功能「跨主机消息传输」：向有当前 ticket 的已信任主机发送文本请求，并等待带同一消息 ID 的确认；超时或取消会结束连接。
DSH Weave 的功能「主机身份持久化」：首次启动生成节点密钥，并默认将身份写入 DSH 状态目录；重启后复用该身份。
DSH Weave 使用前须知：默认会在本机 DSH 状态目录保存身份密钥和配对主机记录；可通过配置关闭持久化或更改路径。（见 lib/index.js:51,74-103,109-140）
DSH Weave 使用前须知：当前版本提供配对、目录访问和请求传输；通用远程任务审批与持久 outbox/断线重放未实现。（见 README.md:68-71）
dsh-weave README · Introduction：

dsh-weave README · DSH Weave：[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh.md) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-weave) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) Connect explicitly trusted DeepSeek Harness hosts through Iroh. Keep pairing, peer identity, reachability, and the remote session directory in one transport layer.

dsh-weave README · What you get：| Capability | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| **Persistent identity** | The same host identity survives restarts. |
| **Explicit pairing** | Exchange endpoint tickets and trust each peer locally. |
| **Encrypted transport** | Iroh provides QUIC connections, direct paths, and relay fallback. |
| **Remote directory** | Discover workspaces and sessions on paired hosts. |
| **Visible state** | Host reachability is separate from agent idle/running/offline state. |
| **Native settings** | Grouped identity and pairing controls, copy feedback, and removal confirmation. |

dsh-weave README · Quick start：On each host:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-weave@latest
dsh web
```

1. Open **Settings → Weave** on both hosts.
2. Exchange their tickets through a channel you trust.
3. Add and explicitly trust the other host's ticket on each side.
4. Use a higher-level plugin such as [DSH Chat](https://github.com/baixianger/dsh-chat) to select remote sessions.
dsh-weave README · Quick start：Add [DSH Bridge](https://github.com/baixianger/dsh-bridge) when messages should reach local agents on a receiving host. Bridge is optional for transport startup.

dsh-weave README · One transport, separate responsibilities：```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Host A · Bridge] --> WA[Weave]
  WA <-->|Iroh · QUIC| WB[Weave]
  WB --> B[Host B · Bridge]

Iroh owns encrypted connectivity. Weave owns host trust, endpoint refresh, reachability, and authenticated requests. Chat owns rooms, membership, and room capabilities. Knowing a ticket alone does not grant trust or agent access.

dsh-weave README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hostName` | System hostname | Display label for the host. |
| `relayMode` | `default` | Iroh default relay selection, or `disabled`. |
| `persistIdentity` / `persistPeers` | `true` | Keep identity and trusted peers across restarts. |
| `acknowledgementTimeoutMs` | `10000` | Default acknowledgement deadline. |
| `maxConcurrentInbound` | `64` | Bound concurrent incoming requests. |
| `shutdownTimeoutMs` | `1000` | Bound transport shutdown. |

dsh-weave README · Configuration：Identity and trusted peers are stored under `$DSH_HOME/dsh-weave` (`~/.dsh` by default), with owner-only permissions. `identityPath` and `peersPath` can override their locations.

dsh-weave README · Cancellation & delivery：Outbound requests accept a cancellation signal. Cancellation closes their connection; the receiving listener is also notified when the peer disconnects. Cancelling a request does not mark an otherwise reachable host offline. Chat's longer polling requests use matching acknowledgement deadlines.

dsh-weave README · Cancellation & delivery：The current release is a **transport MVP**. It provides pairing, directory access, and authenticated request delivery. A general remote task approval workflow and durable transport outbox/reconnect replay are not implemented. Application-level persistence belongs to the consuming plugin.
